findings.evidence: The conclusion concerns decomposition of `p`, and the proof invokes simultaneous decomposition on the restricted endomorphisms of `p`; the ambient hypothesis appears only through the finite-dimensional restriction machinery (`genEigenspace_restrict_eq_top`).
findings.fix: Move `p` before the typeclass and assume `[FiniteDimensional K p]`; adjust/generalize the restriction argument accordingly. The modular-form corollaries can continue deriving this instance from finite-dimensionality of their ambient spaces.
findings.issue: `iSup_inf_iInf_eigenspace_of_invariant` requires `[FiniteDimensional K V]`, excluding finite-dimensional invariant submodules of infinite-dimensional representations.

summary: The invariant-submodule decomposition is stated with finite-dimensionality on the ambient space although only the invariant submodule needs to be finite-dimensional.
